# Disagreement Log — GTH_065

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 65
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 65 | "a good man" | "a creditable man" | "a decent man" | *agathos*: moral goodness vs. social credibility |
| 2 | 65 | "Perhaps he did not know them" | "Perhaps they did not recognize him" | "Maybe they didn't know who he was" | Master's rationalization — subject/object reversal |
| 3 | 65 | "Perhaps they will respect my son" | "Perhaps they will show some respect for my son" | "Surely they'll respect my son" | Second rationalization — certainty vs. uncertainty |
| 4 | 65 | "Whoever has ears, let him hear" | "Let him who has ears hear" | "If you have ears, use them" | Closing formula |

**Total disagreements: 4**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "good man," resolves the rationalization ambiguity by clarifying subject ("Perhaps they did not know him"), and retains the traditional closing formula.
